schemes.name: 2-Byte Node ID + Device Type + TLV (12 34 11 00 ...)
schemes.description: Matches 2-byte Node ID with 1-byte Device Type (Class/Capability), Seq and dynamic Channel-Type-Value sensors (e.g. 12 34 11 00 01 11 09 C4 02 05 0C E4)
schemes.matchCondition:
// Match if at least 4 bytes and byte 0 is not legacy 0xAA
return bytes.length >= 4 && bytes[0] !== 0xAA;

schemes.name: Universal NetID + SenderID + TLV (AA 0C 64 ...)
schemes.description: Matches NetID 0xAA packets with SenderID, Target Gateway, Seq and dynamic Channel-Type-Value sensors (e.g. AA 0C 64 00 01 11 09 C4 02 05 0C E4)

schemes.name: Sensor Node AA0B (Temp / Volt / Seq)
schemes.description: Matches incoming payloads starting with AA0B header

schemes.name: ASCII Text & Test Pings
Cayenne LPP Standard Sensors
schemes.description: Decodes standard IPSO/Cayenne LPP sensors (temp, hum, analog, GPS)
